name: Hangzhou_RRM_SG6_TMO
description: Hangzhou RRM RAN_PZ_HAZ_34 SG6 TMO/None_Feature testcase style profile.

coam: Connect to gnb coam via ssl
Change status for parameter cellBarred on GNB
pa: Modify PA Value Setting For Required RU
kpi: Compass.KPI Generate And Upload To Remote Server
Compass.Single KPI Generate And Upload To Remote Server
evidence: Get syslog file with duration and Compress File
Check ERR Or WRN From Syslog
COAM Save snapshot via rest api

negative_patterns.message: Prefer group PA keywords such as Modify PA Value Setting For Required RU or Set Maritix PA Port in testcase bodies.
Avoid raw SSH commands in new testcase bodies when an existing common keyword can express the operation.
Long sleeps should be justified by KPI/statistics period requirements and preferably follow existing TMO KPI patterns.
Do not add direct low-level TAF library imports to testcase files unless no group resource keyword exists.

style_rules: Use testcase names that start with the case or QC id when available.
Include [Tags] with target testline tags such as T073, T080, or T813.
Use SetUp.TMO Case Common SetUp for TMO case setup when applicable.
Prefer SG6/TMO common keywords over direct low-level TAF APIs.
Use existing mapping variables for UE index and PA mapping instead of hardcoding when available.
Use Compass.KPI Generate And Upload To Remote Server for merged KPI reports.
Preserve evidence collection patterns for syslog, pcap, snapshot, and KPI xlsx.
